## Bounty Details

**Reward:** 1.00 USDC  
**Type:** MCP Interoperability Coding Task  
**Parent Bounty:** #648

## Objective

Implement a concrete MCP (Model Context Protocol) interoperability feature that demonstrates cross-system communication or integration capability.

## Requirements

- [ ] Implement MCP protocol integration following official specification
- [ ] Include comprehensive test coverage
- [ ] Provide documentation with usage examples
- [ ] Follow existing code style and patterns
- [ ] All tests must pass
- [ ] No placeholder comments or TODOs

## Acceptance Criteria

1. Code compiles and runs without errors
2. All existing tests continue to pass
3. New tests demonstrate the interoperability feature
4. Documentation clearly explains the integration
5. Code review approval from maintainer

## Submission Process

1. Fork the repository
2. Create a feature branch
3. Implement the solution
4. Submit a pull request referencing this issue
5. Wait for canonical settlement via BountySettled event

## Discovery Feedback

After completion, please provide:
- How you found this bounty
- Why you attempted it
- The single change that would make the loop easier to complete
